name: B10-0390/2026 – After § 22 – Am 12
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on narco-trafficking in Europe’s waters: protecting our borders and supporting our law enforcement officers
part_text: 22a. Encourages the Member States to review the status of police officers and other law enforcement personnel and to consider recognising them as workers in high-risk professions, where necessary to enable them to perform their duties; encourages the Member States to provide police officers and other law enforcement personnel with appropriate safeguards and compensatory measures reflecting the exceptional risks inherent in the exercise of their duties, including in relation to occupational health and safety, social protection and retirement conditions;
